title: Mortal Kombat 11
provenance: Reported by hisis5707-droid (highball#390, 2026-10-19), Apple M1 with 8 GB, macOS 26, Highball 0.7.6: character faces are distorted on both DXVK and DXMT while clothing and stages look normal (screenshot on the issue). Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Faces are distorted, clothing and stages fine. Still so on Highball 0.10.21 with engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28 and DXMT on an M1 with 8 GB (highball#390, 2026-10-19). That log shows MK11 asking DXMT for a tessellation factor of 32 on 16 pipelines, and DXMT clamping it to 8, its limit on GPUs before Apple9 (M1, M2) for tessellation through mesh shaders. Whether that clamp is what distorts the faces is not confirmed yet; D3DMetal, which has no such clamp, is the test.

knownIssues.symptom: Character faces distorted, clothing and stages fine (DXMT on an M1, Highball 0.10.21, and DXVK on 0.7.6)
knownIssues.cause: not confirmed. On M1 and M2 DXMT caps tessellation at 8 where MK11 asks for 32 (measured in the log), which would flatten detail the game adds to faces
knownIssues.fix: untested. The game's own graphics mode set to D3DMetal
